dev.question: The town library has 18 shelves, and every shelf holds 27 books. How many books can the shelves hold altogether?
Tobin splits 549 letters evenly into 9 bags and adds 5 flyers to each bag. He sends out 3 of the bags, but 8 items from them come back undelivered. How many items were delivered?
Oskar buys 4 boxes of tokens with 43 tokens in each box, then spends 10 tokens on skee-ball. How many tokens does he have left?
A company gives each of its 25 workers 3 scarves for the winter and keeps 15 extra scarves in the office. How many scarves does it buy in all?
Priya buys 6 notebooks at 3 dollars each and one pencil case for 7 dollars, and she hands the cashier 191 dollars. How much change does she get back?
Tobin's class began a decorating project with 181 eggs. First each of 9 groups took 5 eggs, then the teacher added 29 more eggs, and later 6 eggs cracked. How many eggs are left?

Sade's club melted down 243 old medals into bars, using 3 medals for each bar. Each bar sold for 10 dollars, a donor added a bonus of 66 dollars, and fuel for the furnace cost 25 dollars. How many dollars did the club have left?
In the morning the station storeroom held 127 bottles of water. Later a delivery brought 2 cases with 10 bottles in each case, and that afternoon 44 bottles were used. How many bottles remain?
Yuna's first sticker book holds 210 stickers and her second book holds 92 stickers. What is the total number of stickers in both books?
Dmitri caught 49 trout in the morning and 46 more in the afternoon. He gave 18 trout to a neighbor. How many trout does he have left?

heldout_template.question: The weather station kept 96 bottles of distilled water in storage and used 38 of them to refill the humidity sensors. How many bottles are left?
Bruno planted 36 tulip bulbs. Sade planted 12 more than Bruno, and Jonas planted twice as many as Sade. How many bulbs did the three of them plant altogether?
Priya has twice as many orange stickers as Odalys, who has 33. After Priya trades away 15 stickers, how many does she have left?
At the gym juice bar, Kenji sold 68 smoothies at 7 dollars each. After paying 82 dollars for ingredients, how many dollars of profit did he make?
Kenji spent 34 dollars on peaches, and Rosa spent 111 dollars on plums at the roadside stand. How much did they spend altogether?
A train with 390 passengers must seat them equally in 10 carriages. How many passengers sit in each carriage?
Mira has 165 postcards describing the winning projects, and she shares them out equally among 11 judging tables. How many postcards does each table get?
Hugo earned 417 dollars at the bake sale booth. He then bought 19 batteries at 9 dollars each, and later sold an old helmet for 34 dollars. How many dollars does he have now?
At the gym juice bar, Kenji sold 76 smoothies at 6 dollars each. After paying 64 dollars for ingredients, how many dollars of profit did he make?
At the gym juice bar, Kenji sold 38 smoothies at 8 dollars each. After paying 60 dollars for ingredients, how many dollars of profit did he make?

heldout_structure.question: Anselm built 20 model boats for a harbor display. Nia built three times as many as Anselm, and Keiko built 7 fewer than Nia. How many boats did the three of them build altogether?
117 lanterns hang evenly across 3 halls of the museum. Odalys adds 2 lanterns to each hall, and then 8 lanterns are taken down for repair. How many lanterns hang in the museum now?
The museum cafe sold 21 bowls of soup at 5 dollars each and 17 sandwiches at 8 dollars each on a busy Sunday. After paying 27 dollars for supplies, how many dollars of that income remain?

Oskar had 264 tiles and used 102 of them in a hallway. He split the rest equally into 6 boxes, then added 3 extra tiles to each box. If tiles sell for 5 dollars each, how many dollars would one full box bring in?
Bruno splits 585 bricks equally into 9 piles for a museum courtyard wall, then adds 16 more bricks to every pile. After 26 bricks crack and are thrown out, how many usable bricks remain?
Anselm's school sent 2 buses with 33 students each and 4 vans with 11 students each to the museum. Then 29 of those students stayed home sick. How many students actually visited?
Dmitri solved 21 puzzles at the interactive exhibit. Mira solved 11 fewer than Dmitri, and Yuna solved twice as many as Mira. How many puzzles did the three of them solve in total?
Mira's club of 24 members is split equally into 6 tour groups at the museum. Each group pays 29 dollars for a guide plus 8 dollars for every member in it. How many dollars does the whole club pay?
Priya sold 14 blankets at 20 dollars each and 12 lamps at 23 dollars each at a site market, then paid 136 dollars for a stall. How many dollars did she keep?
Tobin buys 2 museum tickets at 19 dollars each and 3 souvenir hats at 9 dollars each. He pays with 237 dollars. How much change does he get back?
